5963.title: Redundant skill-tree reads during catalog resolution
5963.rootCauseOneLine: Catalog candidates are reparsed and their full trees reread and hashed on every scan because the registry has no freshness cache.
5963.proposedFix: Cache candidate frontmatter and tree hashes in the existing registry, invalidating on file-set or stat metadata changes and failed rebuilds.
5963.caveats: The complete baseline regression and output are inline in the report under reports-repository policy. Production timing and workload sizes were not remeasured.
